# Knowledge Graph

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A structured network of entities (nodes) and their relationships (edges), typically machine-readable, used to represent and query interconnected knowledge.

## Scope note

Refers specifically to the Neo4j graph instance mirroring and linking PKM notes and health events. Distinguish from Ontology (schema) and Taxonomy (classificatory hierarchy) - this is the populated data instance.
